purpose: Teach: 買い手/忠告/転用/模範/必読/預かっ/コーディネート/休養

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究成果、買い手、企業に、繋げていく視点、社会人として、本当に、大事だぞ、覚えておけ、絶対、研究、活かせよ、本気で。
lines.en: Ren — as you move forward, connecting your research to real-world applications and the people who can use it, that's what matters. That's essential as a professional. Remember that. Make your research count. I'm serious.
lines.style: Steady, measured delivery. Opens with weight on the name. Pauses between clauses for emphasis. Warm conviction — not lecturing, mentoring. Eyes direct. The tone of someone who has seen research wasted.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先生からの忠告、本当に、いつも、ありがたく、受け止めております、社会人になっても、必ず、活かしてまいります、本当に、感謝。
lines.en: Yes. I'm truly grateful for your guidance. I take it to heart every time. When I become a professional, I'll apply everything you've taught me. Thank you so much, truly.
lines.style: Sincere, slightly formal register. Measured pace. Each phrase given its own respectful weight. Quiet gratitude underneath — not performative, genuine. A pause after 'truly' like the weight of the thanks is sitting with him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 基礎研究の成果、応用研究に、転用していく姿勢、研究者として、本当に、必要だぞ、君も、視野を、広げていけ、絶対に、頑張れ、本当に。
lines.en: The ability to take what you discover in basic research and translate it into real applications — that's vital as a researcher. Broaden your perspective. Push yourself. I mean it.
lines.style: Clear, purposeful. Lands on key words: 'translate', 'vital', 'broaden'. Slightly firmer than before but still warm. Leans forward slightly with the emphasis. The cadence of someone who believes what he's saying.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先輩の研究、模範に、しております、自分の研究にも、活かしていきたいです、本当に、勉強、本当に、たくさん、させていただいてます。
lines.en: Yes. I model my own work on your research, sir. I want to apply what I'm learning to my own studies. You've given me so much to learn from. Truly, I'm grateful.
lines.style: Respectful, earnest. Slower pace than natural speech — choosing each word carefully. Slight shy quality underneath, but not weak. The tone of someone whose admiration is genuine and slightly humbling.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文執筆の、必読書、何冊か、紹介してやろう、勉強しろ、本当に、君の論文、もっと、よくなるはずだ、絶対だ、本当に、頑張れ、本当に。
lines.en: I'll introduce you to some essential reading for academic writing. Study them. Your papers have room to grow — they will improve. You need to do this. Keep pushing.
lines.style: Practical, direct. Opens with 'I'll' — takes ownership. Lands firmly on 'study' and 'improve'. Not harsh, but no softening either. The tone of a mentor who knows what's needed and expects follow-through.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先生から、預かった研究資料、本当に、慎重に、扱っております、責任、感じております、絶対、紛失しないように、徹底、本当に、私。
lines.en: Yes. I handle the research materials you've entrusted to me with real care. I feel the weight of that responsibility. I won't lose anything. I'm being thorough, absolutely thorough.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. Spoken with careful deliberation — each phrase given space. Slight tension underneath, the tension of someone taking a promise seriously. Not anxious, but concentrated. The voice of commitment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文発表会、服装、コーディネート、本当に、しっかり、考えろ、社会人として、当然、見られているからな、絶対だ、本当に、頼んだ、絶対。
lines.en: Think carefully about how you'll dress and present yourself for the presentation. People are watching — that's just part of being a professional now. It matters. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Calm, direct advice. Opens with quiet emphasis on 'carefully'. Slight pause after 'watching' — letting the reality of it settle. Warm underneath, but the firmness is clear. The tone of someone who cares about your future.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究の合間、休養、しっかり、取るようにしております、本当に、健康、第一、心がけております、社会人になってからも、続けます、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. I make sure to rest between research sessions. Health comes first — I'm careful about that, truly. I'll keep doing that even once I'm working professionally. Absolutely.
lines.style: Steady, earnest. Measured delivery with quiet pride in the discipline. Not rushed. Each clause given equal weight — these are commitments he's already keeping. Slight warmth at 'truly' — speaking to something personal.
